Here’s a classic, well‑balanced ingredient list for a moist, flavorful chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Amount (for a 9‑inch round cake) | Notes |
|------------|----------------------------------|-------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Use a high‑quality Dutch‑process for richer flavor |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | Adds sweetness and helps with browning |
| Baking powder | 1 ½ tsp | Leavening agent |
| Baking soda | 1 ½ tsp | Works with acidic cocoa for extra lift |
| Salt | 1 ½ tsp | Balances sweetness |
| Eggs | 2 large | Room temperature for better emulsion |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Can substitute with buttermilk for tang |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) | Keeps cake tender |
| Vanilla extract | 2 tsp | Enhances overall flavor |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Intensifies chocolate flavor and keeps batter thin |
| Optional: 1–2 tbsp coffee |  | Boosts chocolate depth |

**Optional extras for extra richness:**
- **Dark chocolate chips or chunks** (¼–½ cup) – fold in after mixing the batter.
- **Chocolate frosting** (cream cheese or buttercream) – for topping.
- **Whipped cream or ganache** – for a decadent finish.

**Tips:**
- Preheat your oven to **350 °F (175 °C)**.  
- Grease and flour two 9‑inch round pans (or line with parchment).  
- Mix dry ingredients together first, then combine wet ingredients separately before adding to the dry mix.  
- Add boiling water last; the batter will be thin—this is normal.  
- Bake for **30–35 minutes** or until a toothpick comes out clean.  
- Let the cakes cool in the pan for 10 min, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before frosting.

Enjoy your chocolate cake!
